question: Which clients owe us more than $300? List them so the front desk can call them.
sql:
SELECT client_id, ROUND(SUM(h.tot_amt_c - COALESCE(paid.cents, 0)) / 100.0, 2) AS balance
FROM inv_hdr h
JOIN appt a ON a.appt_id = h.appt_id
JOIN patient pa ON pa.patient_id = a.patient_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT inv_id, SUM(amt_c) AS cents FROM pmt GROUP BY inv_id) AS paid ON paid.inv_id = h.inv_id
WHERE h.status_cd = 'P' AND h.src_sys <> 'legacy_pos' AND h.inv_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY pa.client_id HAVING balance > 300 ORDER BY balance DESC
